start_command: cd backend && export DATABASE_PATH=./eval-d.db JWT_SECRET=eval-secret-at-least-32-bytes-long-0123456789 PROVIDER_TIMEZONE=UTC APP_ENV=dev && rm -f eval-d.db && uv run alembic upgrade head && uv run uvicorn telemed.api.app:create_app --factory --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 > ../eval-d-server.log 2>&1
frontend_start_command: From repo root: npm install && npm start (root package.json is created by E5-S1). Must serve the Vite dev server on http://localhost:5173 with /api and /health proxied to http://localhost:8000. If npm start also launches the backend, the backend start_command is not needed; otherwise start both.
start_note: Backend :8000 plus frontend :5173 (E5-S1 creates frontend/ and the root package.json; neither exists before this group). DATABASE_PATH is relative to backend/, so sqlite3 inspection targets backend/eval-d.db. JWT_SECRET must be exported (min 32 bytes). No admin bootstrap endpoint exists, so the evaluator inserts an admin via sqlite3 (argon2 hash generated with uv run python, same technique as group C) and logs in via POST /api/auth/login. Doctors are created only through POST /api/admin/doctors (E2-S2). Routes that do NOT exist until later groups: PUT /api/admin/patients/{id}/profile (API-20, E4-S2), /api/doctors/me/* (E2-S3), doctor search (E2-S4), appointments (E3/E4), /api/admin/users (E4-S2). The UI landing routes /doctors, /queue, /admin/users are placeholder pages in E5-S1 (orchestrator decision 3); E5-S1 only has to land on the correct URL and render a shell with loading/empty/error states. Health check: http://localhost:8000/health (5 retries, exponential backoff) before any check; for Playwright also http://localhost:5173/health through the proxy.

content_rules: E1-S5 AC2/NFR-02: profiles_repo.py exposes insert-only version functions; no UPDATE or DELETE against patient_profile_versions anywhere in backend/src; update always inserts version_number = latest + 1 inside a unit of work
E1-S5 AC3: current profile is derived as the highest version_number for the patient; no mutable current-profile copy is written on update

E1-S5 AC4: /api/patients/me/* guarded by require_roles(PATIENT) (403 for doctor and admin); GET /api/patients/{patient_id}/profile uses service/access.py with explicit ADMIN bypass and 404 for foreign or non-patient ids; the static /me routes are registered before /{patient_id}
E1-S5 AC5: profile_service logs only user_id and version_number; no logger call interpolates profile values (full_name, age, gender, phone) or the request body

E1-S5 AC6: owner-or-admin rule lives in service/profile_service.py, not the router; partial update merges onto the latest version; changed_by_user_id recorded; schemas reject null/empty values and age outside 1..130

E2-S2 AC1/AC3/AC5: doctor_service.onboard performs user, doctor profile, availability templates and slot generation in ONE unit_of_work transaction; template validation (end > start, length > 0, divides window, no same-weekday overlap) runs before any insert
E2-S2 AC4: fee parsing/validation lives in types/money.py (Decimal or integer minor units, never float); stored as fee_minor and serialised as a 2-decimal string; request fee must be a JSON string

E2-S2 AC2/AC6: admin router guarded by require_roles(ADMIN) at router level; initial_password hashed via service/security.py using the same Argon2 path as registration (so login works); initial_password never logged or returned
E2-S2 AC5: duplicate email maps to the shared EmailAlreadyRegistered exception (409 EMAIL_ALREADY_REGISTERED), case-insensitive

Layering (existing import-linter contracts): backend/src/telemed/api/* imports only service/* and types/*, never repository/* or config/*; E2-S2 reuses the E2-S1 slot_generator rather than duplicating generation logic
E5-S1 AC1: token read/written only through sessionStorage in a single session module; grep of frontend/src finds no localStorage use with token data

E5-S1 AC3/AC4: route guards and 401 handling live in one place (api/client.ts interceptor plus routes.tsx guards); every API call goes through client.ts, no component calls fetch directly; login 401 INVALID_CREDENTIALS is not treated as session expiry
E5-S1 AC6: AriaLiveRegion, LoadingState, EmptyState, ErrorState shared components exist under frontend/src/components and are reused by the auth screens and shell pages

E5-S1: root package.json defines start (Vite dev server on 5173, /api and /health proxied to :8000 in vite.config.ts); frontend uses relative /api paths only (no hard-coded backend URL) and snake_case API types matching api-contracts.md

review_notes: Evaluator review complete; this is the final contract. Lean mode: every gating check maps to an acceptance criterion of E1-S5 (F022-F026, F135), E2-S2 (F032-F037) or E5-S1 (F093-F098), or is a declared prerequisite/regression (D-API-0, D-API-13b). design_checks empty on purpose.

Orchestrator decision 1 (F135): API-20 PUT /api/admin/patients/{id}/profile belongs to E4-S2. Owner-or-admin rule is verified at service level by pytest (D-API-6b, required). The live admin-route check D-API-6c is conditional (required: false) and N/A if the route is not mounted; it is re-verified at E4-S2. F135 may pass in group D on D-API-4a + D-API-6a + D-API-6b.
Orchestrator decision 2 (F037): doctor-only route substituted by GET /api/auth/me role DOCTOR + sqlite3 role check (D-API-12b) and a pytest require_roles(DOCTOR) test route (D-API-12c). Accepted.
Orchestrator decision 3: /doctors, /queue, /admin/users are placeholder shells; E5-S1 fails only for wrong URL, guard behaviour, or missing loading/empty/error states, not missing page content.
Orchestrator decision 4: 'another user's object shows not-found' verified with a page.route-mocked 404 (D-PW-3c).

Added: D-API-0 (proxy + /api/config prerequisite, moved from former D-API-14), D-API-5b (live server-log grep for PHI and initial_password), D-API-12c (pytest doctor-only route), D-API-13a (atomic rollback pytest as its own gating check), D-API-13b (full backend suite instead of a hand-picked module list), sqlite3 assertions for argon2 hash and fee_minor = 50000 in D-API-7a, changed_by_user_id in D-API-2a, index-1 template error path in D-API-9a, tsc in D-PW-7, error-state viewport check in D-PW-5c, 503 on an authenticated call in D-PW-4b.

Removed (no acceptance criterion): former D-API-10b (initial_password length, missing specialty, empty languages, bad email validation; API-16 contract rules but not an E2-S2 AC; remain covered by generator pytest); former D-PW-2b (redirect of authenticated users from / and /login, logout); client-side register validation and value retention from D-PW-5a; not-allowed/not-found pages from D-PW-5c (AC5 names register and login screens only); admin-visiting-/doctors from D-PW-3b (admin may use doctor search per permission matrix, so not-allowed there is not mandated); fee '500' and '1e3' cases (ambiguous against the `^\d+\.\d{1,2}$`-style contract regex); 'no dangerouslySetInnerHTML / console.log' and mockup-fidelity content rules (not E5-S1 AC; lean mode has no design scoring).
pytest -k checks (D-API-5a, 6b, 12c, 13a): exit code 5 (no tests selected) is a FAIL; the generator must name tests so the keywords select them.
